Both render well. Two quick confirmations to close this step:

**Choosing the status while saving/editing** (`prototypes/shot-25-save-status-toread.png` and `shot-26-save-status-finished.png`)
The review/edit card now has an **"Add to"** choice — **📖 To read** or **✓ Finished** — defaulting to *To read*, with a line explaining the effect ("Kept in your To read view until you mark it finished" / "Saved straight to Finished — it won't appear in To read"). The same choice appears when you edit a bookmark later.

**The library behaviour** (from Arrangement B, `shot-23-status-segmented.png`)
Opens on **All** (your whole library) with a **To read / Finished / All** switch and a status badge on each card. Marking something **finished removes it from the To read view**; **moving it back restores it there**.

Does this match your intent — status chosen at save/edit, default *To read* for new saves, landing on **All**, and finished/reopen moving items in and out of the To read view? If yes, I'll record it and we'll move to the next piece — **archiving** links you want to keep without cluttering the main list.
